_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for site navigation. `place` decides where a group or CTA lives on wide screens: 'masthead' = the top bar (the parent-facing conversion path), 'rail' = the slim left shelf (free content for returning students). Everything is ALSO rendered into the rail markup so the mobile drawer holds the whole nav; CSS hides the masthead-placed items there on wide screens. Consumed by src/lib/nav-render.mjs, scripts/build-nav.mjs, and the two Python generators. Change nav here and nowhere else.
